claims.text: Myanmar’s tourism account describes existing Dagon renamed Yangon. Its mission distinguishes Mandalay’s planning from capital inauguration. NAM describes Rangoon’s 1852 capture and Mandalay’s 1885 occupation before Thibaw’s surrender. These are distinct city and conquest events, not simultaneous foundation, timeless British rule or consent; occupation and annexation must not be merged.
